name: VNDC
oneLiner: VNDC is Jade Labs's VND-denominated token, now disclosed as VNDC 2.0 backed by USDT/USDC pools under issuer and investigation risk.
collateral: Issuer-disclosed VNDC 2.0 USDT/USDC smart-contract collateral on Polygon and BNB Smart Chain; reserve and redemption claims remain high-risk after the March 2026 ONUS/VNDC investigation
pegMechanism: Issuer-controlled mint and redemption through ONUS/VNDC Hub; VNDC 2.0 disclosures describe USDT/USDC collateral pools rather than direct VND bank reserves, with redemption reliability impaired by the March 2026 investigation and withdrawal disruptions

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Explicit Possible retained: centralized issuer with discretionary mint/redeem authority; contract source not independently audited and ONUS deployment retains administrative pause and reissue privileges.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: VNDC is issued natively and independently on each chain by Jade Labs via owner/whitelist-controlled mint and redeem - the Ethereum contract (VNDCToken, Solidity 0.4.11) uses owner issue()/burn(), and the BSC and Polygon contracts (both TokenVNDC, Solidity 0.8.18, byte-identical source) use mintWhitelist()/withdrawWhitelist(). None of the three deployments contain any OFT, LayerZero/CCIP/Wormhole/Axelar/Hyperlane messaging, lockbox, or bridge interface, and the addresses differ per chain (ruling out a deterministic-CREATE2 omnichain standard). The Polygon deployment is independent issuer mint, not a Polygon PoS bridge-minted token (no deposit/childChainManager/DEPOSITOR_ROLE). Cross-network movement is handled off-chain through the ONUS/VNDC Hub app (redeem on source, reissue on destination), with no autonomous on-chain bridge carrying the durable supply, so this is native multichain issuance rather than an opaque bridge route.

notices.title: Vietnam criminal investigation and withdrawal freeze
notices.message: Vietnamese authorities arrested ONUS/VNDC-linked executives in March 2026 in a fraud and money-laundering investigation involving VNDC, ONUS, and related tokens. Local reporting also described platform withdrawal disruptions during the investigation, so VNDC redemption and reserve claims should be treated as high risk.

notices.title: Market cap and supply inconsistency
notices.message: Aggregator-reported market cap (~$50M) does not consistently match on-chain Polygon/BSC supply, and reserves are self-disclosed by Jade Labs without an independent audit cadence.

notices.title: Curated reserves are self-reported
notices.message: The curated-validated live-reserves adapter points at the Jade Labs / VNDC issuer website because no third-party attestation page has been verified. Reserve composition reflects the issuer's own disclosure only until an independent auditor or proof-of-reserves feed is published.

mintAuthority.summary: VNDC is issued by Jade Labs (Singapore) and operated through the ONUS/VNDC Hub platforms; minting and redemption run through an issuer-controlled, admin-gated token with no third-party audit and no permissionless mint route.

controls.label: Jade Labs / VNDC issuer admin (owner-controlled issue/redeem)
controls.evidence: BSC owner() returned this EOA at block 103627465; eth_getCode returned 0x (EOA confirmed). Issuer admin can authorize owner-controlled supply operations.

controls.label: Jade Labs / VNDC issuer admin — Polygon
controls.evidence: Polygon owner() returned the same EOA (0x557D55E71204CE7DfDc5C839446Dd34F1b299354) at block 88323540; eth_getCode returned 0x (EOA confirmed). Same issuer-admin EOA controls both BSC and Polygon deployments.

review.evidence: BSC block 103627465 and Polygon block 88323540: owner() on both deployments returns the same EOA 0x557D55E71204CE7DfDc5C839446Dd34F1b299354; eth_getCode returned 0x on both chains confirming EOA. Polygon blocker resolved — same address as BSC. All mint-capable surfaces confirmed.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: VNDC 2.0 is an issuer-controlled reserve token described as backed by USDT and USDC collateral pools.
